src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Chapter 93 of the Acts of 2021 (H.4256, 'An Act establishing Congressional districts', signed Nov. 22, 2021); 9 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Bill H.4256 (192nd): enacted Nov. 17, 2021, signed Nov. 22, 2021, Chapter 93 of the Acts of 2021
First used in the 2022 elections. Census cb_2022 cd118 file: 9 districts; all 9 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 17 percent); equals the 2024 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: Chapter 82 of the Acts of 2021 (S.2563, 'An Act establishing senatorial districts', signed Nov. 5, 2021); 40 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Bill S.2563 (192nd): passed Oct. 28, 2021, signed Nov. 5, 2021, Chapter 82 of the Acts of 2021

Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022, 40 districts, named D01 to D40 in the 2021 act's order; the 2020 file's districts are not the same districts. Equals the 2024 file (max difference 0.1 percent). District ids and names differ between the 2020 and later Census files: the cb_2020 sldu file numbers districts in the Census's older scheme (001 to 040) and names them differently from the cb_2022 and cb_2024 files (D01 to D40); match by the district's printed name or by the plan's own order, never by id across years.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: Chapter 83 of the Acts of 2021 (H.4217, 'An Act relative to establishing representative districts in the General Court', signed Nov. 4, 2021); 160 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Bill H.4217 (192nd): passed Oct. 28, 2021, signed Nov. 4, 2021, Chapter 83 of the Acts of 2021

Census cb_2022 sldl file: LSY 2022, 160 districts; equals the 2024 file (max 0.1 percent). District ids and names differ between the 2020 and later Census files: the cb_2020 sldl file numbers districts in the Census's older scheme (060 to 219) and names them differently from the cb_2022 and cb_2024 files (001 to 160); match by the district's printed name or by the plan's own order, never by id across years.
